stops.detail: To the north lies the Vallée de Joux at an altitude of 1,000m.

stops.name: Lac de Joux
stops.detail: A unique location, interesting geology and extraordinary climatic conditions shape the character of the landscape at Lac de Joux, the Jura Mountains’ largest lake.

stops.name: Espace Horloger - Vallée de Joux

stops.name: Mont Risoux massif
stops.detail: The park areas can be divided into the gorges of the Orbe and Nozon rivers, the Jura ridge between Col de la Givrine and Col du Mollendruz / Dent de Vaulion, the southern foot of the Jura, the Mont Risoux massif and the Vallée de Joux.
